classification.difficultyReason: Match each perpendicular height to its corresponding base despite rotated figures, external heights and irrelevant side lengths, then apply A = bh.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these parallelograms.

spec.description: Right-leaning parallelogram with horizontal base 10 cm, slant side 7 cm and internal dashed vertical height 6 cm. Opposite horizontal sides have single ticks and single parallel arrows; slant sides have double ticks and double parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Base 10 cm and perpendicular height 6 cm; 7 cm is a redundant side measurement.
spec.answerVisibility: All measurements and marks are permanent givens. The supplied area is excluded from this diagram.

spec.description: Tall parallelogram with vertical sides, sloping upper and lower edges, vertical side 12 cm, upper slant side 9 cm and dashed horizontal perpendicular distance 5 cm. Vertical sides carry single ticks and upward parallel arrows; sloping sides carry three ticks and paired parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Use the vertical 12 cm side as the base and the horizontal 5 cm perpendicular distance as the height.
spec.answerVisibility: The measurements remain visible; the supplied 60 cm² response is stored separately.

spec.description: Oblique parallelogram with a 15 cm long side descending right, an 11 cm shorter side rising slightly right and a dashed 8 cm perpendicular height from the upper-right vertex to the opposite 15 cm side. Long sides carry single ticks/arrows; short sides carry double ticks/arrows.
spec.mathematics: The height 8 cm corresponds to the 15 cm base, not the 11 cm side.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear in the question diagram.

spec.description: Small right-leaning parallelogram with horizontal side 5 cm, slant side 7 cm and dashed perpendicular height 4 cm from the lower-right vertex to the opposite slant side. A right-angle square marks the height foot. Horizontal sides carry double ticks/arrows; slant sides carry single ticks/arrows.
spec.mathematics: The 4 cm height is perpendicular to the 7 cm side. Therefore A = 7 × 4 = 28 cm².
spec.answerVisibility: All source measurements are retained. The incorrect supplied 32 cm² is excluded from the unsolved prompt.

spec.description: Oblique parallelogram with lower long side 20 cm, left short side 13 cm and dashed 12 cm perpendicular height from the upper-right vertex to the lower long side. The height foot carries a right-angle square. Long sides have single ticks/arrows; short sides have double ticks/arrows.
spec.mathematics: Use base 20 cm with perpendicular height 12 cm; retain the redundant 13 cm side.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied 240 cm² response is stored only in the answer.

spec.description: Left-leaning parallelogram with bottom horizontal side 9 cm, left slant side 10 cm and dashed 8 cm perpendicular height from the upper-right vertex to the left slant side. Horizontal sides carry double ticks/arrows; slant sides carry single ticks/arrows.
spec.mathematics: The 8 cm perpendicular height corresponds to the 10 cm side, not the 9 cm side.
spec.answerVisibility: All source givens remain visible and the area response remains hidden in the answer field.

spec.description: Broad left-leaning parallelogram with bottom side 12 cm and right slant side 6 cm. An exterior dashed vertical 5 cm height drops from the upper-left vertex to the extended bottom-side line, with a right-angle square and double-ended height arrow. Horizontal sides carry single ticks and parallel arrows; slant sides carry double ticks.
spec.mathematics: Base 12 cm and exterior perpendicular height 5 cm; the slant side 6 cm is redundant.
spec.answerVisibility: The source area response is excluded from the question diagram.

spec.description: Flattened rhombus with horizontal top and bottom edges, each side marked with a single equal-length tick. The bottom and right sides are both labelled 6 cm. A dashed, double-ended 5 cm perpendicular height joins the lower-left vertex to the right slant side, with a right-angle square at its foot.
spec.mathematics: Use the 6 cm right slant side and its perpendicular 5 cm height. All sides have equal-length marks.
spec.answerVisibility: The two 6 cm labels and the 5 cm height are retained; the supplied area is stored separately.

spec.description: Tall parallelogram with vertical parallel sides and upper/lower edges descending right. The upper slant side is labelled 8 cm, the right vertical side 11 cm and the exterior horizontal perpendicular distance 7 cm. The left side continues downward as a dashed guide to a right-angle square; a dashed double-ended horizontal arrow ends at the lower-right vertex. Slant sides carry double ticks; the left vertical side carries a single tick; vertical sides carry upward parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Use vertical base 11 cm and horizontal perpendicular height 7 cm, retaining the redundant 8 cm slant side.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens appear in the question diagram.
